question: What file formats do you accept?
answer: We recommend print-ready PDFs with bleed. We also accept AI, EPS, SVG, and high-resolution PNG/JPG files.

question: How long does production take?
answer: Most orders are produced within 1–2 business days after artwork approval. Shipping time depends on your selected delivery method.

question: What is your minimum order quantity?
answer: Minimum order quantities vary by product. Many business card products start at 50 pieces; gang-run products typically start at 200 copies per design.

question: Do you offer design services?
answer: Yes. We offer free vector typesetting for print customers, template layouts, and custom original design. Visit our Business Card Design Service page to get started.

question: Can I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking link by email. You can also view order status in your dashboard.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: If you're not satisfied with the print quality due to a production error, contact us within 14 days. We'll reprint or refund eligible orders.
